source_quotes.n_subjects: Subject 1 (female, age 26) provided written informed consent to participate in the ongoing epilepsy device study.
source_quotes.conditions: PLI-FUS (548 kHz) was emitted across multiple hippocampal targets in a human subject with temporal lobe epilepsy using a mechanically steered piezoelectric transducer.
source_quotes.adverse_events: A firstin-human PLIFUS course of treatment was successfully delivered using the device platform with no adverse events.
source_quotes.safety_notes: A firstin-human PLIFUS course of treatment was successfully delivered using the device platform with no adverse events.
source_quotes.exposures[0].target.label: PLI-FUS (548 kHz) was emitted across multiple hippocampal targets in a human subject with temporal lobe epilepsy using a mechanically steered piezoelectric transducer.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.protocol_description: A schematic and photos of the final platform design are provided in Figure 1. Stimulation pulse trains lasting for 140 s (Fig. 1b) were successfully delivered to multiple hippocampal targets and repeated in biweekly therapy sessions for 3 weeks in subject 1 with TLE.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: The custom device was designed and constructed in the Focused Ultrasound Laboratory at Brigham and Women’s Hospital, Boston, Massachusetts (S.T.B.). PLIFUS was emitted using a spherically focused airbacked piezoceramic transducer (Piezo Kinetics, Bellefonte, PA, USA; PZT-4, 548 kHz, 5-cm diameter, focal length 6.7 cm) mounted with silicone adhesive in an acrylic housing that maintains air backing under water.

flags.reason: Range (0.14-0.32 MPa) and Ispta range (0.5-2.25 W/cm2) are stated only in the Figure 1 caption, not in the Results text (which gives only the maximum, 0.32 MPa / 2.25 W/cm2); recorded here as the full stated range but flagged as figure-legend-sourced.

Only PRF (500 Hz) and duty cycle (36-50%) are stated for the internal pulsing within the 500-ms sonication; no explicit pulse/cycle count is given to state a pulse duration, so left not_reported rather than computed.
Text and figure caption both give duty cycle as "36% 50%"; likely an en-dash lost in OCR representing a 36-50% range across sessions/targets, recorded as [36, 50].
Paper states treatment was 'repeated in biweekly therapy sessions for 3 weeks' but never gives an explicit session count.

direction_notes: This technical note reports device delivery and safety only; no neuromodulatory outcome or seizure/EEG effect was assessed or reported for this first-in-human PLIFUS course.
safety_notes: A first-in-human PLIFUS course of treatment was successfully delivered using the device platform with no adverse events.

target.label: human hippocampus (multiple hippocampal targets, seizure onset zone)

device.model: PZT-4, 548 kHz spherically focused piezoceramic transducer

timing.protocol_description: 140-s sonications emitted to each hippocampal target with 500-ms sonications repeated with 7-s inter-stimulation intervals, lasting 140 s per target; treatment repeated across multiple hippocampal targets (four targets) and repeated in biweekly therapy sessions for 3 weeks in subject 1 with TLE.
